sophia: Heads up — after converting a Llama4 checkpoint into the Mistral-bridge layout and running our int4 sparse-KV + headfusion path, summarization quality dropped ~7 ROUGE L on the smoke set. small sample diff below, reproduced across 3 seeds.

sophia: ```
ref: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
base (fp16): The quick brown fox jumped over a lazy dog. (ROUGE-L: 0.82)
quant (int4 sparse-kv; headfusion on): The quick brown fox ran. (ROUGE-L: 0.75)
```

sophia: Not catastrophic but consistent and shows up in long-context trims. Anyone seen this pattern with proj-order / pos-rot interactions? :thinking_face:

dmitri: Which conversion script/flags did you use? model tag + tokenizer?
sophia: tag: ll4-mistralbridge-v2 (git rev 7e2f3d). tokenizer: llama-tokenizer v1.2. convert flags: `--swap-proj-order --sparse-kv --head-fuse` (we tried both swap/no-swap). quant: `int4-dq` w/ per-channel scale.

dmitri: ok. please run the rotor/posrot sanity (we've seen a subtle phase-degen when proj-order != expected). can you also dump kv-cache states for a few tokens? I suspect a headwise phase sign flip.

anya: Also check embedding-projection order — if proj order changed, the rotary frequency alignment can degrade for long ctx. run embed-consistency and longctx-sanity.

bench-bot: quick perf snapshot (model=ll4-mistralbridge-v2,int4-dq,headfusion):
- p50 latency: 84ms
- throughput: 18 req/s (batch=1)
- mem: 6.8GB
- anomaly: kv-cache warmup shows different magnitude on head 3 vs head 7

li: repro steps I used (local):
```bash
# convert
python convert.py --src ll4.fp16 --dst mistralbridge --swap-proj-order --sparse-kv --head-fuse --out ./converted
# quant
python quantize.py ./converted --mode int4-dq --per-channel
# run eval
python eval_smoke.py --model ./converted/int4 --dataset smoke_summ --dump-kv kv_dumps/
```
li: kv_dumps includes per-step KV tensors and rotary cos/sin tables we build at load. share link when done.

anya: If you can, run `python kv_diff.py kv_dumps/base/ kv_dumps/quant/ --head 0,3,7 --tokens 0:64` — it'll show per-head magnitude + phase offsets. I suspect a ~pi/2 offset on some heads when `--swap-proj-order` is used with sparse-kv.

dmitri: I want to flag that headfusion path applies a reorder for fused matmuls. If proj-order doesn't match the fused layout, the rotary indexing can be applied to wrong subvectors. We missed an assert in the bridge converter that validated `proj_layout == runtime_layout`.

sophia: ok running the kv-dump + kv_diff now. will post outputs. assigning follow-ups: @dmitri to add converter assert, @anya to run embed-consistency, @li to collect full kv_dumps. I'll iterate on repro and push a temporary pinned model to the dedicated pool.

infra-bot: Model ll4-mistralbridge-v2 pinned to dedicated-pool-prod:tag=triage-4591 at 4591234578. No traffic routed from public hosted until unpinned.

bench-bot: ran kv_diff head 3 — sees phase shift ~1.58 rad on token 32..36, amplitude scale mismatch ~0.92. attaching gist: https://internal.gists/4591/kvdiff (private)

anya: that ~1.58 rad == pi/2 basically. suggests a quarter-phase slip. I think the rotary cos/sin build assumed chunking by `proj_heads` but headfusion merged dims. fix candidate: align rotary stride with fused-proj dims or undo headfusion for affected heads.

li: quick patch I tried: disable head-fuse at convert-time (`--no-head-fuse`) then quantize -> quality returned to baseline on smoke set (ROUGE-L back to 0.81). so head-fuse interaction looks causal.

dmitri: good repro. I'll add converter assert + a unit test that compares built cos/sin table shapes and kv indexing against reference. will also add a short warning log when head-fuse enabled with swapped proj-order.

sophia: perfect. can we triage fix + hotpatch to dedicated pool today? timeline?
dmitri: PR in ~2h, hotpatch after tests ~+4h if CI green.

anya: I'll run a longer 1k-example eval overnight with and without head-fuse + int4 to confirm no regressions in other prompts. posting results tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

sophia: thanks team. keeping thread open for logs. I'll update pinned tag when we push the hotpatch. :rocket:
